base_source: TTM owner's earnings from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (filed 2026-07-16): TTM OCF = FY2025 $8,431M - H1 2025 $5,927M + H1 2026 $6,409M = $8,913M; TTM capex = FY $5,874M - H1'25 $2,520M + H1'26 $3,015M = $6,369M; TTM OE pre-SBC $2,544M, less $148M FY2025 AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense (the engine's ShareBasedCompensation tag is stale since 2013 and reads $0) = $2,396M / 326.7M H1 2026 diluted shares = $7.33/share. Engine median base was $7.78 pre-SBC.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 6.4x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
moat_justification: Irreplicable hub geography (Newark, San Francisco, Denver, Houston, O'Hare fortresses; largest U.S. carrier across Atlantic and Pacific), MileagePlus loyalty economics with cash-up-front co-brand sales, scale/upgauging unit-cost advantage and a premium mix compounding at +14-16% — against a price-transparent commodity seat product, union labor and fuel capturing the economics each cycle, negative OE in 2 of the last 5 years, and 6.4x net debt / normalized OE.
name: United Airlines Holdings, Inc.
one_liner: Best-network U.S. airline, moat 4/10 — executing well (record revenue, premium/loyalty compounding, guidance raised into a fuel shock), but on TTM SBC-adjusted owner's earnings of $7.33/share the $103.45 price yields only a 10.1% weighted IRR (IV@15% $62.35) because cyclical OE levered 6.4x must carry a heavy fleet-capex cycle; it clears 15% only at ~$62, ~$50 with a margin of safety.
